sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Now, Republicans are about to make a mistake on health care and betraying a promise.
sentences.zh: 现在，共和党人即将在医疗保健问题上犯下错误，并背叛一项承诺。

sentences.en: It is inescapable that this bill in its current form will betray the very promise that Donald J.
sentences.zh: 不可避免的是，这项法案以目前的形态将背叛唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump made.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾作出的承诺。

sentences.en: The fate of President Trump's giant domestic policy bill has become uncertain after two Republican senators, including Tom Tillis of North Carolina, vowed to vote against it.
sentences.zh: 在两名共和党参议员（包括来自北卡罗来纳州的汤姆·蒂利斯）发誓投票反对该法案后，特朗普总统庞大的国内政策法案的命运变得不确定起来。

sentences.en: And half a dozen other Republicans remained undecided.
sentences.zh: 另外还有半打共和党人仍然态度未决。

sentences.en: In a fiery speech from the Senate floor, Tillis said that he could not support the bill because it risked kicking his constituents off of Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 蒂利斯在参议院发言时言辞激烈，称他无法支持该法案，因为它有让他的选民失去医疗补助（Medicaid）的风险。

sentences.en: So what do I tell 663,000 people in two years or three years when President Trump breaks his promise by pushing them off of Medicaid because the...
sentences.zh: 因此，当特朗普总统因为推动政策导致他们失去医疗补助而违背承诺时，两年或三年后我该怎么向663,000人交代呢，因为...

sentences.en: Trump can only afford to have three Republican senators oppose the legislation,
sentences.zh: 特朗普只能承受最多三名共和党参议员反对该立法，

sentences.en: which would extend his 2017 tax cuts and pay for part of them by cutting Medicaid and food benefits for the poor.
sentences.zh: 该法案将延长他2017年的减税政策，并通过削减针对穷人的医疗补助和食品福利来支付其中一部分费用。

sentences.en: The president has set a deadline of Friday for the bill to be passed.
sentences.zh: 总统已为该法案的通过设定了周五的最后期限。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration has determined that Harvard University violated federal civil rights law by failing to protect its Jewish and Israeli students from harassment during protests on campus over the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府已经认定，哈佛大学在加沙战争校园抗议期间未能保护其犹太和以色列学生免受骚扰，从而违反了联邦民权法。

sentences.en: That conclusion could increase pressure on Harvard to reach a legal settlement with Trump,
sentences.zh: 这一结论可能会增加哈佛大学与特朗普达成法律和解的压力，

sentences.en: who has already cut Harvard's funding by billions of dollars and sought to prevent international students from attending the university.
sentences.zh: 特朗普已经削减了哈佛数十亿美元的资金，并试图阻止国际学生入读该大学。

sentences.en: Both sides are currently engaged in negotiations over a potential settlement.
sentences.zh: 双方目前正在就潜在的和解方案进行谈判。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，党内就陷入了一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人热血沸腾的争斗之中。
